Python FastAPI React Developer at BairesDev

As a Python FastAPI React Developer, you will build and maintain high-performance fullstack web applications. You will connect modern backend services with intuitive user interfaces, ensuring optimal performance, scalability, and seamless user experiences across our digital products.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain efficient and secure backend APIs.
  • Build responsive, dynamic, and highly interactive user interfaces.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define architecture and product requirements.
  • Ensure optimal application performance, code quality, and state management.
  • Implement robust database schemas and optimize data queries.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Fullstack Software Engineering or Web Development.
  • Proven expertise in building backend applications using Python and FastAPI.
  • Strong proficiency in developing dynamic user interfaces using React.
  • Solid understanding of RESTful API architecture and modern database systems.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.
